note: The compiled-runtime toolchain for tests and benchmarks (tools/bend_loader.ts, tools/spectests.py, tools/run_runtime_tests.py, tests_generated/fuzz_objects.py, benchmarks/checks/*): stock upstream Bend 2.0.34 (release bend-2.0.34-linux-x64.tar.gz from github.com/bendlang/bend). The runtime sources (src/digest.bend, src/sha256.bend) use the 2.0.34 Base API after the port, so the 2.0.28 build no longer compiles them. Set BEND_RUNTIME to the binary (the paths below are the maintainer's laptop; every evidence file records the sha256 of the binary and Base it actually used). base.bend is the 2.0.34 release's, byte-identical to the checker's (toolchain.lock.json). No proof check uses this file; the checker is pinned in toolchain.lock.json.
